source: Owner clarification and live Laws Chamber tablet screenshots supplied on 2026-08-14.
purpose: Clarify that the Laws Chamber donor is not merely a side-by-side layout precedent. Its deeper architectural value is state-driven information delivery: keep only a limited amount of high-value information visible at once, retain a stable control/object frame, and let visitor interaction replace the active information in place without accumulating parallel explanatory blocks.

lawsInformationDeliveryReference.law: The Compass should behave like an instrument with a stable presentation surface whose content changes with active state, not like a document that reveals every available explanation at once.
lawsInformationDeliveryReference.notJustLayout: Side-by-side composition is secondary to the architectural delivery model. The essential donor is bounded visible information plus interactive state substitution inside a stable frame.

deliveryArchitecture.choiceVisibilityLaw: The visitor may see the available choices or controls concurrently, but only the currently active choice should expose its full explanatory payload.
deliveryArchitecture.informationBudgetLaw: Primary screen area is reserved for the active state. Peer states remain identifiable or selectable without each consuming a full explanatory card.
deliveryArchitecture.replacementLaw: Changing foreground, tab, selected feature, room, or proof state replaces the active content within the designated information surface rather than appending a new equivalent surface below it.
deliveryArchitecture.continuityLaw: The presentation frame remains spatially stable enough that the visitor understands that the information changed because their selection changed.
deliveryArchitecture.responsiveInvariant: Desktop, tablet, and phone may use different physical arrangements, but all must preserve the same bounded active-state substitution model.

compassApplication.spatialLabels: Exactly one active spatial label is visually readable at a time; changing foreground state changes that label in place.
compassApplication.contextSurface: Exactly one current cardinal/room explanation should dominate the contextual surface. Rotating or selecting replaces the active explanation rather than adding another block.
compassApplication.featureDelivery: Where lower-page features contain peer or alternate proof/information states, prefer persistent compact choices plus one active detail surface over stacking all equivalent details simultaneously.
compassApplication.coherenceAndHouse: Coherence Diagnostic and Talk to the House may remain simultaneously discoverable as peer choices, but should not each require a fully expanded equal-weight explanatory card if a shared active detail surface can preserve clarity.
compassApplication.builtDifferent: Built Different proof points should use a compact selector or equivalent persistent choice mechanism with one active proof explanation where this reduces card accumulation without hiding the existence of the proof set.
compassApplication.lawsSideBySideRelationship: On wide viewports, pair the active object/control or compact choice set with its current information surface. The content surface may update while its spatial role remains stable.
compassApplication.tabletRelationship: Tablet should preserve the Laws Chamber behavior visible in the owner-supplied reference: stable selection affordances, a bounded active preview/detail area, and no requirement to expose every peer explanation at once.
compassApplication.mobileRelationship: On phone, preserve the same active-state information architecture even when the visual layout collapses vertically. Mobile collapse must not become information accumulation.
compassApplication.progressiveDisclosure: Additional depth remains available through explicit visitor intent, but only the currently useful layer should occupy primary visual attention.

stopLaw: If implementation requires new destination topology, new Compass geometry, route changes, scientific authority changes, or replacement of direct manipulation with surrogate navigation, stop and reclassify before construction.
